# Final baseline rebind review

Final adapter `77dece96…` passes this independent source review and is ready for
root's integration. It binds published repair `ddd4a6a8…`, manifest `67d68693…`,
with 339 baseline runtime files. [final-review.json](final-review.json) records the
exact source transitions and limits. This review does not run or authorize an
actual archive operation; root's release gates and committed phase pins remain
required.

The [source-only audit](static-rebind-first.json) passed 13 checks. The adapter AST
is unchanged from counter-corrected `a3370ac8…` except the two baseline assignments.
Published Git bytes and the worktree match the new manifest. Exactly the reviewed
transport test changed; 338 baseline files are unchanged. Pure core and all other
fixed source/prerequisite/producer pins remain exact. Contract changes are the
baseline pins and the accurate six-runtime-Python/two-contract-docs distinction.

The [first generated rebind execution](rebind-first/execution.json) passed four
existing source/context guard methods in 1.677 seconds unittest / 4.780429400
seconds process time, with zero guard violations and all 339 runtime files held.
The other 46 behavior methods were not rerun for this pin-only change. The final
portable file retains all 51 methods; its original 50-method file is an unchanged
prefix, so the four selected bodies are the same ones destined for promotion.
Root's eventual integrated full run must be recorded separately.

Evidence remains chronological and append-only: the initial 50-method pass after
six reviewer-fixture failures; the later genuine historical-counter regression
with 16 failure records; the corrected five-method/33-variant pass; and this
four-method rebind pass. Static-check counts are not test counts, and repeat runs
are not additional distinct methods. No private inputs, actual workbook, network,
real-checkout guard or scientific evaluation was used.

The [final additive inventory](final-inventory.json) lists this evidence only.
Copy its entries plus final-inventory.json/final-handoff.json, retain both new
`.log` files, and verify their actual Git blobs before publication. Earlier
[behavior](handoff.json) and [counter](counter-handoff.json) bundles stay unchanged.
